source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Dusko — quick context on J\_DISP\_LED:

The e-paper has no built-in light, so we're adding an external LED behind it as a backlight. I haven't picked the final LED yet (testing a 5V COB strip first, may switch to a 3.3V frontlight module later), so the circuit needs to cover both.

Please populate for this build:
\- BSS138 (low-side switch, GPIO42 PWM controls brightness)
\- 10kΩ gate resistor + 10kΩ gate pull-down (keeps LED off during boot)
\- 5V jumper on Pin 1 — leave the 3V3 jumper footprint empty
\- 4.7µF X5R 0603 cap from Pin 1 to GND (PWM ripple decoupling)
\- Series resistor footprint: leave DNP (LED strip self-limits)
\- No flyback diode — LED is resistive, not inductive

Worst-case current is ~70mA (5W/m strip × 67mm cut), well inside BSS138's 200mA rating.

The 3V3 jumper + DNP series R footprint exist only as fallback for a future bare-LED option — costs nothing to leave them empty now.

Full spec is in <http://pcb-integrated-v2.md|pcb-integrated-v2.md> under the J\_DISP\_LED rows / pinout / Critical Routing.
